scope: Only paired-floor summary arithmetic: common-valid point estimands, paired covariance and delta uncertainty, all-planned operational coverage, metric domains and fixed row accounting.

validation.fixture_scope: Literal fabricated records with canonical metadata and descriptive synthetic hashes; no observation arrays or random draws were generated.

independent_checks: Every common-subset bias, MSE and RMSE is recomputed on the identical paired valid-point intersection; own-only errors deliberately make own-valid metrics materially different.
Paired bias and MSE MCSEs agree with exact rational sample moments using denominator S-1.
RMSE-difference uncertainty agrees with an independent gradient/covariance expansion including the negative covariance term.
Log-RMSE-ratio uncertainty agrees with 5/28 and yields the specified multiplicative normal-approximation interval; the ratio MCSE includes its scale factor.
Proportional errors A=2B give ratio2 with zero observed log-ratio influence variance through covariance cancellation.
All R planned pairs enter operational coverage, including unavailable intervals with finite misleading endpoints; all 4 contingency counts and paired sample-variance uncertainty agree.
Zero-truth mu relative fields remain undefined while absolute mu metrics and absolute RMSE ratios retain their correct domains; sigma relative fields use abs(truth).
CV0 identical controls have unit ratio and zero difference uncertainty only when the relevant sample size and positive-RMSE domains permit.
S0, disjoint valid subsets, S1, R1, zero numerator, zero denominator and both-zero RMSE cases preserve unavailable uncertainty rather than fabricate zero standard errors.
A disjoint S0/R2 example retains operational coverage MCSE1 and unbounded approximate interval [-1.959963984540054,+1.959963984540054], confirming no clipping.
The complete frozen physical grid produces exactly72 directional rows, and one complete three-floor CV subset produces18; no reference-to-self row is introduced.
Input order is deterministically reversed in reference cases; sorting/pairing follows canonical CV, source anchor, estimator and replication identities, while irregular array hashes may differ.

interpretation_caveats_confirmed: Coverage difference intervals are unbounded normal Monte Carlo approximations and are not clipped.
Coverage MCSE is undefined for R<2, including singleton CV0 control.
Zero observed paired variance at positive CV does not prove zero population variance or population equality.
These are simulation-summary uncertainty estimates, not replacements for registered fitted-parameter intervals.

limits: Approval concerns exact reviewed paired-arithmetic code and documentation, not full source provenance, storage lifecycle or complete scientific artifact auditing.
Literal formula tests establish arithmetic and domain handling, not calibrated finite-sample confidence coverage or simultaneous guarantees across the grid.
No full floor-sensitivity experiment, follow-up experiment, selected headline replay, future module or Week8 work was performed by this reviewer.
